data: Vračata se dva „miličnika“ Janez in Franci. Po 20 letih. Prvič sta se pojavila v filmu Milice (1997) in nato v filmu Na svoji Vesni (2002). Tokrat se morata spopasti s češko mafijo in njenim vodjo Franto. (An archaeologist and a weapons designer, who knew each other in a previous life as a filmmaker and a psychoanalyst, meet at an excavation site in the Negev desert and begin a conversation about love and war.)

Vračata se dva „miličnika“ Janez in Franci. Po 20 letih. Prvič sta se pojavila v filmu Milice (1997) in nato v filmu Na svoji Vesni (2002). Tokrat se morata spopasti s češko mafijo in njenim vodjo Franto.

An archaeologist and a weapons designer, who knew each other in a previous life as a filmmaker and a psychoanalyst, meet at an excavation site in the Negev desert and begin a conversation about love and war.
